title: pvDistributePoints
body:
## pvDistributePoints

Redistributes the points of a point set across MPI processes into spatially contiguous regions with roughly equal point counts, by recursively splitting the points in two (a k-d tree). Output is polydata containing the points and their point data but no cells; input cells are ignored. Use it in MPI runs to balance particle or point-cloud data before point-based processing.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- The output has no cells, so it is not drawn and cell-based filters see nothing.
- Schemaxis serial examples do not establish MPI behaviour. Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `DistributePoints`. Identity: `filters/DistributePoints`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. Accepted data: explicit-point datasets (polygonal, unstructured or structured grids) (vtkPointSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkPointSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |
